body.name: P_SI
body.def: \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{SI}}(\mathcal O)\) records, on \(\mathcal E(\mathcal O)\), the observed-endpoint mark common to all \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), and a circle otherwise. The compatibility fiber uses the observational \(U_0=V\) signature associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}\), and, for every \(k\in[K]\), the complete \(U_k\)-level adjacency and unshielded-collider signature of \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), including all \(\zeta_k\)-involving constraints.
